name: GCP — API Access From External / Non-Corporate IP
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = google_cloud_logging_raw
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| filter not (xdm.source.ipv4 contains "10." or xdm.source.ipv4 contains "192.168." or xdm.source.ipv4 contains "172.16." or xdm.source.ipv4 contains "172.17." or xdm.source.ipv4 contains "172.18." or xdm.source.ipv4 contains "172.19." or xdm.source.ipv4 contains "172.2" or xdm.source.ipv4 contains "172.3" or xdm.source.ipv4 contains "35.235.240.")
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count_distinct(xdm.source.ipv4) as ips, count() as api_calls,
       values(xdm.source.user.username) as users,
       values(xdm.event.type) as operations,
       values(xdm.event.description) as events_seen
       by xdm.event.description, _time
| filter api_calls >= 5
| fields users, events_seen
description: GCP Cloud Audit event with caller IP outside RFC1918 ranges and not in GCP's IAP forwarding range (35.235.240.0/20) — ≥5 API calls per hour from external IP.
alert_name: GCP — API Access From External / Non-Corporate IP
